product.name: Vectorline
product.headline: Price infrastructure without the spreadsheet.
product.description: Model a production workspace by seats and monthly API traffic. Every charge stays visible, predictable, and ready to share.

howTo.question: What counts as an API call?
howTo.answer: Each accepted request to the production API counts once. Retries caused by Vectorline infrastructure and traffic to sandbox environments are excluded.

howTo.question: How do usage tiers work?
howTo.answer: Rates are progressive. Each slice of traffic is priced at its tier rate, so crossing a threshold never reprices earlier calls.

howTo.question: Is this a binding quote?
howTo.answer: No. This local calculator creates a planning estimate only. Taxes, negotiated terms, and optional support packages are not included.
